The acceptance cascade already mints tasks at runtime (jobs/cascade/decisions.ts:362) — this is AUTHORING + ad-hoc assignment, not a task engine. (1) Full CRUD on task_templates: POST/DELETE + PATCH beyond file_config (task-templates.routes.ts currently GET + file-config-PATCH only). Fields: name, kind acknowledge|file|form, description, due_at OR due_offset_days (CHECK makes them mutually exclusive — the eval wants literal dates like 2027-05-01, so the UI must expose due_at); kind=form requires form_id. (2) POST for direct speaker-task assignment: title, due date, MULTI-speaker select, bypassing auto_assign. (3) Fix TaskTemplatesPage: remove the file-kind-only filter (:173), give the empty state the control it instructs you to use (:183), sidebar/settings link (EventSettings links venues but not tasks). Full spec: section T-E. Register rows 24,25.

**MRQ-114 complete — PR #83 open.** https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/83

## Local gate — PASS

```

 Test Files  89 passed (89)

{
  "command": "pr-gate",
  "ticket": "MRQ-114",
  "status": "pass",
  "elapsedMs": 88309,
  "budgetMs": 120000
}
```

Rebased onto `github/main @ 514f9f4` before the run; `npm ci` after the rebase per COMMON.md.

## Shipped

Full CRUD on `task_templates` (POST/PATCH/DELETE beyond file_config), `POST/GET /speaker-tasks` for direct multi-speaker assignment bypassing `auto_assign`, `GET /task-assignees`, and the page rebuilt as a **Tasks** area: sidebar entry, settings card, inline create form with a literal `type="date"` due date and a searchable multi-speaker picker, every task kind listed, each row expanding to its assignments with Pending/Complete.

Rubric: **CNT-01** (w3) and **SPK-05** (w2).

## Deviate-with-flag — three, all in the PR body

1. **The assignment route is in `task-templates.routes.ts`, not `onboarding.routes.ts`** as T-E names. `speaker_tasks.template_id` is `NOT NULL`, so every assignment resolves a template; the endpoint belongs with the validation it shares, in a file T-E owns outright. `onboarding.routes.ts` untouched.
2. **The assignment POST takes `template_id`, not the ticket's "title"** — same constraint; a titled task with no template needs a migration this ticket does not authorize. Create-with-`assign_to` makes it one operator action.
3. **"Tasks" is the one sidebar row the binding prototype does not carry.** T-E requires the entry and cross-cutting fact 2 makes the noun scoring surface. I did **not** touch DESIGN.md or the prototype; `tests/unit/route-table.test.ts` was updated and records why. **If the contract should instead be amended, that is yours to decide.**

## Reviews

- Plan review (auto-fired, single): **PASS**, five MINOR findings, all triaged in the plan's Cycle-2 block. Two needed code — per-row `created_at` anchors for offset-mode propagation, and one shared UTC due-date formatter across the portal, chase board, and Tasks page (they formatted locally, so an end-of-day instant read as the next day east of Greenwich).
- Code review (auto-fired, single): **timed out after 600s** at 1-min load 199. Per COMMON.md's timebox rule I fell back to self-review; artifact attached with `--role review`.

## Validation — attached, `--role validation`

Real local Worker on seeded data (9,976 rows, 1,097 people), then the real page in a browser. Both CNT-01 fixture tasks with their literal 2027 dates and both speakers; SPK-05's three mark-complete tasks; re-assign returning `{"assigned":1,"skipped":2}`; DELETE refused with "30 speakers have already completed this task"; every validation error a 422 naming its field. Created **"Upload Session Presentation" through the form in the browser** — row reads "Due May 1, 2027", expands to *0 of 2 complete*, both speakers **Pending**.

**The browser pass caught two defects green tests could not**, both fatal to CNT-01:
1. Ticking a second speaker dropped the first, and ticking a speaker after typing a due date silently wiped the date — every draft handler spread state captured at render time.
2. Task names rendered at `width: 0` (measured, not inferred): `overflow: hidden` zeroes a flex item's automatic minimum size, so adding the kind badge squeezed the name out of a row built for two items.

Self-review added two more: the picker was 1,097 unsearchable checkboxes with a "Select all" that would assign to all of them, and the assignment list shipped 25KB of instructions nothing renders.

## Named residual risk

`GET /speaker-tasks` has no pagination — 354 rows / 148KB on the seeded event, 20ms. Fine at this size; a much larger conference would want `?template_id=` filtering on expand. Not built, because the honest fix is a measurement away rather than a guess now.

Row-level **Edit** and **Delete** were exercised through the API but not through clicks — c11's browser IPC was failing intermittently under fleet load and I stopped driving it rather than burn the session.

The hermetic suite passed but took 82.6s against the 45s objective under load 54.48; no test failures. Accepted PR #91 main deletion of generated cli/api-registry.json; it is not tracked or present in the pushed tree. PR #83 remains pr_open for Merge Warden; no merge performed.

Correction after concurrent main advance: github/main moved to ebd697cf (MRQ-108) and was merged cleanly; final HEAD 18eace6 is pushed. Final npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-114 PASS: 96 test files / 649 tests, suite 35.1s within 45s, API 148 operations, route map, types, build, shell truth, design, and merged AC trace all pass with 0 uncovered. cli/api-registry.json remains deleted and absent; PR #83 is still pr_open for Merge Warden. No merge performed.
